name: Astral Reef Shark Expanse
introDiscord: The sheltering coral abruptly ends. Beyond it stretches open blue water crossed by fast currents and distant fins. Three routes leave the safety of the reef, and none provide much cover.
introTwitch: The sheltering coral abruptly ends. Beyond it stretches open blue water crossed by fast currents and distant fins. Three routes leave the safety of the reef, and none provide much cover.

bluewater-margin.prompt: The bluewater margin marks the last shelter before open ocean. Three exposed currents leave the coral wall while distant fins repeatedly cross their paths.

left.message: Shizuki's Bluewater tonic reads: "Shark tested, elf approved, bottle mildly bitten. Tester unavailable for comment."
left.fullHpMessage: The mildly bitten Bluewater tonic remains unused. You are already at full health; the absent tester may keep its silence.

right.message: A Moonkeeper cache rests just beyond the coral wall. Retrieving Star Candies requires entering open water for approximately twelve very long seconds.

forward.message: A fin cuts across your route. It disappears. Another appears farther away. The Astral Reef Shark is not lost. It is measuring you.

predator-meridian.prompt: Pale stones mark an old crossing through exposed water. Three routes extend from it while shadows repeatedly pass beyond the edge of sight.

left.message: An Astral Reef Shark approaches slowly, turns aside at the last second, then circles back faster. The first pass was a warning.

right.message: Shizuki's cache reads: "Take a breath. Fear is useful; panic has poor navigation. Also sharks can tell when you swim like an idiot. Allegedly."
right.fullHpMessage: Shizuki's breathing-point cache remains closed. At full health, you can focus on navigating without swimming like an idiot.

forward.message: A moon-shell coffer lies between two marker stones. You retrieve Star Candies during the narrow gap between circling fins.

open-reef-run.prompt: The final channel leaves almost no shelter. Three currents cross beneath the restless surface while every distant silhouette has enough room to approach from anywhere.

left.message: A Fae vessel drifts directly in the open. You recover Star Candies while experiencing the deeply unpleasant sensation of being the most visible object in the ocean.

right.message: An Astral Reef Shark appears beneath you instead of ahead. It has learned from the previous encounters. Wonderful.

forward.message: One Berry is tied to Shizuki's shark-crossing diagram beside the safest breathing point. Her route follows directly behind the predator everyone else avoided. "Can't surprise me if I'm following it. Strategy."

boss-antechamber.name: Apex Gyre
boss-antechamber.prompt: The currents spiral into a broad gyre beyond the final reef marker. Smaller fins circle its edge, leaving the center conspicuously empty.

bossPromptDiscord:
The smaller fins disappear.

One enormous wake begins circling the entire gyre.

Each lap draws closer.

Use /yes to face the Astral Reef Apex or /no to return to the coral before the next circle closes.
bossPromptTwitch:
The smaller fins disappear.

One enormous wake begins circling the entire gyre.

Each lap draws closer.

Use !yes to face the Astral Reef Apex or !no to return to the coral before the next circle closes.
bossRetreatText: You return toward the coral as the enormous wake completes another circle behind you.

boss.revealText: The circling wake breaks as an enormous shark surges through the gyre. The Astral Reef Apex closes in!

completionText: The Astral Reef Apex turns away and vanishes into open blue. The smaller sharks remain distant long enough for you to cross. You do not waste the opportunity.
